title: Multi-Party Authorization of Maintenance Prescriptions on a Permissioned Blockchain
abstract: arXiv:2611.34662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In industrial prescriptive maintenance, an equipment supplier's model may recommend an intervention that a plant schedules, a contractor executes, and a quality or safety function approves. A shared ledger records who submitted the prescription, yet cannot check whether the agreed model and decision rule produced it. We require permissioned-blockchain endorsers to verify a succinct proof of that calculation before releasing a work order. On a four-organization Hyperledger Fabric testbed using a public engine benchmark, this stopped all nine contested or mis-operated prescriptions, whereas hash checks accepted four that either raised simulated maintenance cost or reintroduced late failures.

translated_title: 许可区块链上维护处方的多方授权
translated_abstract: 在工业预防性维护中，设备供应商的模型可能会推荐一项干预措施，由工厂进行排期、承包商执行、并由质量或安全部门批准。共享账本虽然记录了谁提交了该维护处方，却无法核查它是否由约定的模型和决策规则所产生。我们要求许可区块链的背书节点在发放工单之前先验证该计算的简洁证明。在一个使用公开发动机基准测试的四组织 Hyperledger Fabric 测试平台上，该方法阻止了全部九条有争议或操作不当的维护处方，而传统的哈希校验却接受了其中四条——这些处方要么提高了模拟维护成本，要么重新引入了延迟故障。
tldr: 该论文提出要求许可链背书节点在发放工单前验证维护处方计算的简洁证明，从而在多组织协作的工业预防性维护中成功拦截了全部有争议或操作不当的处方，而传统哈希校验会漏掉其中近一半的风险处方。
en_tdlr: The paper requires permissioned-blockchain endorsers to verify a succinct proof of the prescription calculation before releasing work orders, successfully blocking all contested or mis-operated maintenance prescriptions in a four-organization Hyperledger Fabric testbed where hash checks would have accepted nearly half of them.
